content_sections.heading: RITES Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. PERS/9/6/ BLR/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RITES notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: BE/B.Tech in Civil Engineering or equivalent from a recognised University/Institute Experience: Officer having worked in SAG/SG in IRSE Group 'A' services at Level-14/13 (at least 03 years in Level-13) as per 7th CPC or equivalent. Age limit: Maximum 63 years (as on 1 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for RITES Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Those who have been imposed any major/minor penalties during the last 5 years of service

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Negotiable remuneration to be decided as per policy of the company on approval of CV by client. Purely on contractual basis initially for a period of one year, extendable until completion of the assignment subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: 2 recent passport size colour photographs High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications Detailed CV Pension Payment Order Service Certificate, Last Pay-slip, indicating last grade and basic pay drawn issued by the last employer PF No with the last employer Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card etc)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Register on RITES web site under Tab Career - Expert Registration - registration for Consultant/Expert. Submit a print out of the same and self attested copies of required documents in hard copy. Mail detailed CVs to [email protected] with contact details. Make sure it reaches by 24 November 2026.
